race.title: Paddy Power Gold Cup Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A typically competitive renewal of the Paddy Power with preference going to BLUEKING D'OROUX , who improved since being fitted with headgear for Paul Nicholls and makes his debut for Dan Skelton over a track and trip that should suit his prominent-racing style. Madara was a revelation when winning the Plate at the Festival and has to be respected after a spin over hurdles, whilst fellow Festival winner Meetmebythesea remains unexposed and can continue to improve in his second season over fences. BLUEKING D'OROUX (FR) MADARA (FR) MEETMEBYTHESEA (IRE)
